title: Large changes in full view go unseen when their transient is masked

statements.text: When the local transient of a change is swamped by a global flicker, a saccade, a blink, a film cut or decoy mudsplashes, observers have great difficulty seeing changes even when they are very large and occur in full view. The outside memory idea prompted these experiments.

sources.quote: observers have great difficulty seeing changes, even though the changes are very large, and occur in full view
was the impetus for a number of surprising experiments performed recently on “change blindness”
